caption:
Card interest rates, per the Fed. 💳

Q3 2026 (preliminary): 21.19% across all accounts at commercial banks, and 22.36% on accounts actually charged interest.

That's why carrying a balance gets expensive.

Does your card's APR match that, or is it higher?
first_comment: Do you know your card's APR right now? 👇

card.headline: Fed: card APR is 22.36% on accounts paying interest.
